text: The definition of representation in Revised Rule 2019 leaves it unclear whether attorneys who merely monitor a bankruptcy case for a client, without soliciting or advocating a position before the court, represent those clients for disclosure purposes.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Hedge Funds’ Systemic Risk Disclosures in Bankruptcy (2013). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2348463

isBasedOn.name: Hedge Funds’ Systemic Risk Disclosures in Bankruptcy

abstract: it is unclear if attorneys who merely monitor a bankruptcy case on behalf of a client but do not solicit or advocate a position before the bankruptcy court "represent" their respective clients under Revised Rule 2019.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: attorneys retained to monitor rather than advocate
Revised Rule 2019 definitions of represents and disclosable economic interest
